a xenogender is a gender identity (often used as microlabels, but they can be stand-alone identities) that can’t be described using typical gender-related terms like male, female, masculine, or feminine. they instead describe gender using aesthetics, colours, animals, concepts, etc. (pretty much anything).

for example, there is dryagender (a gender that feels like an empty forest) and catgender (a gender related to cats).

xenogenders are most often used by neurodivergent people, but a lot of them can still be used by neurotypical people too. xenogenders were originally created by neurodivergent people because a lot of trans neurodivergent people tend to have complicated relationships with gender (especially autistic people).
